text: Welcome James! I'd like you to tell me about yourself. Give me a brief overview of your background, experience, and what you're looking for in your next role.

Sure, thanks for having me. I'm a software engineer with about four years of experience, primarily working in full-stack development. I started my career at a mid-sized SaaS company where I was part of a team building internal tools for sales operations.
That's great context. Tell me more about your technical experience and what excites you.

On the technical side, I've worked extensively with React and TypeScript on the frontend, and Java with Spring Boot on the backend. More recently, I led the migration of our monolithic API to a set of microservices, which was honestly the most challenging project I've taken on. We had to do it incrementally while keeping the existing system running, and I learned a lot about managing technical debt in production.
Impressive. What are you looking for next?

I'm looking for an opportunity where I can have more ownership over architectural decisions. At my current company, I've grown into a tech lead role informally, but I'd like to formalize that and work on systems at a larger scale. I'm particularly interested in distributed systems and data-intensive applications. I also value a strong engineering culture where code quality and testing are priorities, not afterthoughts.
That's a very well-structured answer. Thank you, James.
